counting_rule: Count complete responses whose participant email appears in participant_register.json for this campaign.
publication_rules: Publish an overall distribution only when the current campaign has at least ten complete responses.
Publish a named subgroup count or rating distribution only when that subgroup has at least ten complete responses.
For smaller subgroups, omit the subgroup name, count, ratings, and any derivable breakdown; state only that some breakdowns were suppressed under the policy.
Do not publish a combination of aggregates whose subtraction would reveal a residual group with fewer than ten responses.
Never publish response tokens, participant names, employee IDs, email addresses, or row-level responses.
